verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a payments and ramp platform, so a batch payout API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows single-user off-ramp flows run through the widget, plus enterprise claims about stablecoin issuance, 'distribution infrastructure' and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion. Nothing documents a batch or bulk disbursement API that pushes many payouts in one operation with per-item status.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can run mass disbursements — batch or bulk payout APIs that push many stablecoin or fiat payouts in one documented operation with per-item status
